contributions.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' line 1 TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED AS CORRECTED BY THE FILER — 6,361.05 hand-written ABOVE a struck-through 2,700.00 — which is also Schedule A's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' (6,361.05) and its printed 'Total Contributions Received' (6,361.05), and is echoed at summary lines 4 and 5 (both 6,361.05)
contributions.detail: The 5 Schedule A rows sum to 500.00 + 1500.00 + 200.00 + 500.00 + 3661.05 = 6,361.05 EXACTLY = the schedule's own printed page subtotal = its printed Total Contributions Received = the corrected Column A. THIS ALSO TRACES THE COVER'S OWN CORRECTION AND CLOSES THE CHUNK'S FLAGGED RATCLIFFE QUESTION. On the p2 Summary Page the filer first entered 2,700.00 in BOTH Column A and Column B on line 1, then struck both through and wrote 6,361.05 above each. The struck figure is not a mystery and was never a second report: the FOUR outside contributions on Schedule A (500.00 + 1500.00 + 200.00 + 500.00) sum to exactly 2,700.00, and 2,700.00 + the filer's own 3,661.05 self-contribution = 6,361.05. The filer totalled only the outside money first, then added his own and corrected the cover. Per the frozen contract, the handwritten correction over the struck value governs. THIS SIDE IS NOT `cumulative-exact`: Column A and Column B carry the same figure here because this is the FIRST report of the 2010 cycle (Seven days preceding the Primary Election, 6/14/10), so the period IS the year to date — the schedule is period-scoped and closes on the promoted per-period cell. Nothing was differenced across covers.

expenditures.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' line 2 TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE (6,361.05) on the p2 Summary Page, equal to Schedule B's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' (6,361.05) and its printed 'Total Expenditures MADE' (6,361.05), and echoed at summary line 6 (6,361.05)
expenditures.detail: A TRACED +0.02 FILER-ARITHMETIC DELTA, retained verbatim and not nudged. The 18 Schedule B rows as read sum to 6,361.07 against a printed page subtotal of 6,361.05. WHAT WAS TRACED: no row is omitted from the filer's own subtotal and none is double-counted — all 18 written entries are present on the one Schedule B page, the page subtotal and the Total Expenditures line carry the same 6,361.05, and the cover's line 2 Column A and line 6 carry it a third and fourth time, so the 6,361.05 anchor is printed five times across the filing (counting Schedule A's matching total) and is not itself in doubt. The residual is a two-cent addition slip in the filer's own column-adding. EVERY cents pair was escalated to 1,200-2,000 dpi tight crops before this verdict: rows 2 (15), 8 (04), 9 (02), 12 (57), 13 (05), 14 (79), 15 (97) and 16 (27) rendered unambiguously, and the two cells whose raised superscripts remain glyph-ambiguous are row 4 J.C. Penney '42' and row 18 Sprint '24' — each of which, if it were '40' or '22', would close the page to the cent. THE ARITHMETIC DOES NOT CHOOSE BETWEEN THEM (two candidate cells absorb the same 0.02), so neither was altered: GOTCHAS' 'closure outranks glyph reading' resolves a UNIQUE ambiguous digit, and this one is not unique. Both rows carry needs_review=1. The whole side is published; the sum stated here is 6,361.07 and the document's is 6,361.05, and both figures are on the record. Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' also prints 6,361.05 and is never summed as an increment; it equals Column A only because this is the cycle's first report.

Office Seeking hand-written 'COUNTY SURVEYOR'; party 'REPUBLICAN'; residence city Springville, Utah (street line printed unredacted on the cover and deliberately not carried). legacy_colAB variant, 4 pages, each classified from its OWN printed header: p1 COVER, p2 SUMMARY PAGE (located by its printed header), p3 SCHEDULE A, p4 SCHEDULE B. Report type: 'Seven days preceding the Primary Election', marked X. Signed 6/14/10; clerk stamp 'JUN 14 PM 5:55'. THE AMENDMENT QUESTION IS LEFT WHOLLY UNANSWERED — neither Yes nor No is ticked and the Date-of-Report rule is blank; an honest BLANK, never read as 'No' (Addendum A4). ~ THE FLAGGED COVER IS RESOLVED, AND IT IS NOT `cumulative-exact`. The chunk brief flagged this filing because its cover prints 6,361.05 as BOTH the per-period and the cumulative contribution figure while another figure in the cycle reaches only 2,700.00. Reading the pages settles both halves. (a) Column A equals Column B because this is the FIRST report of the 2010 cycle — the reporting period IS the year to date — not because the schedule restates the cycle; the schedule is period-scoped and closes on the promoted per-period cell, so the verdict is `exact`. (b) The 2,700.00 is not another report at all: it is a STRUCK-THROUGH figure on THIS cover, entered in both columns and then corrected to 6,361.05, and it equals exactly the four outside contributions on Schedule A before the filer added his own 3,661.05. No two covers were differenced to establish any of this. ~ FOLIATION: this filer numbers the sheets 'Page 2 of 4', '3 of 4', '4 of 4', i.e. counting the cover as page 1 — a THIRD foliation convention alongside Addendum A4's Poulson '1 of 1' / '1-2-3 of 3' pair and the Tracy filing in this same chunk, which numbers every sheet '1 of 1'. Page ordinals still locate nothing. ~ THE DOCUMENT IS A FAX, AND THE FAX HEADER PROVES A MISSING SHEET THAT IS NOT A GAP IN THE FILING: every page carries 'Jun.14. 2010 4:52PM Ut Co Public Works 801-851-8612' (4:53PM on the last) and a fax-side page number, and those run 'P. 2' through 'P. 5' — so the transmission began with a fax cover sheet that the county did not retain. The campaign report itself is complete (its own foliation says 4 of 4 and both schedules close), so this is a transmission artifact, not a missing schedule page. ~ THE FILER EDITED THE PRINTED FORM ON SCHEDULE B: he struck the word 'Contributor' out of the column header 'Name of Contributor' and wrote 'Recipient' above it, and struck 'Received' out of 'Total Expenditures Received' and wrote 'MADE' below it — correcting two county mislabels on the 2010 blank (the same header errors are visible, uncorrected, on the other 2010 filings in this chunk). ~ SIDE STATES: contributions close EXACTLY on the corrected per-period Column A; expenditures carry a traced +0.02 filer-arithmetic delta against their own printed subtotal, retained verbatim (see the recon detail).
